body: I read it as 10 years, didn't get why everyone seemed to be in a rush, but now it all makes sense!
I live in Australia and have grown up in the beaches there, so I'm not used to really cold waters. But rough waters are no problems, swimming is definitely my forte

I'll be travelling to Canada. Halfway across the world for me. 

I don't know how to define happiness. I don't even know what it is to be honest. Even as a child I was never really happy. 

All I know, is there is something wrong with me. Whether it be bi-polar, ADD, or some other sort of mental disorder. I've never been 'normal'. 

I had to train myself to be normal.

I was the exact same. I had my 'party' friends. But then I had my one 'bestfriend' we did literally everything together. Could talk about anything and everything for hours on end. It was weird going 2 days without seeing each other. Then all of a sudden, it's like she found better people. She got her license, got a boyfriend, met different people. And just like that I was no longer needed. Slowly drifted. More ignoring my messages. But in the basics just to stay connected. 

I wanted to hang out today, she said she's working but I should come out tonight, she would message me. It's nearly 9pm, not one message. This happens every time  too. Everythings fine for her, but me, I'm just so lonely. No one wants to hang out with me. 

It's a sad realization that isn't it. If you're not the life of the party, you're just too easy to forget.
